items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: See, him and John Robichaud was partners Them was two violinists

ctx.x: Yeah I got a straight See, him and John Robichaud was partners Them was two violinists And one would get a rich job Well, Robichaud couldn't get off him But Batiste, we was out in the field, you see And everything Robichaud would get Well, just like If I'm connected with another band If I get something I ain't going to give it to nobody else I'm going to give it to the one I'm connected with Well, that's where Robichaud used to know
Speaking of getting off What kind of music did Robichaud play?
